snippet.title: Half-Life: Deep Cover
snippet.description:
DEEP COVER is a Black Operations themed single-player modification for Half-Life, where you take the role of a Black Operations Officer who is tasked with infiltrating a squatted facility of deserted H.E.C.U. soldiers.
While making use of new features like an inventory system with keycards and various items to collect and use and puzzles to solve, this mod aims to otherwise not stray too far away from classic Half-Life gameplay.
The levels do include verticality, so don't forget to look around if you're feeling stuck. Not every solution is directly available from the ground floor.
https://www.moddb.com/mods/half-life-deep-cover
